note: Room configuration foundation for the Kitten Nest world. This file documents current active coffeeCorner ports, approved coordinate anchors, and element cards for future director/runtime work. It is not a full roomEngine runtime yet.

currentRuntime.stableWorkflow: Alex update package -> /write -> generate drafts -> publish all -> /cloud

coffeeCorner.lineRule: Each non-empty line becomes one rotating bubble. If there is only one bubble, the 19.8 hotspot still re-shows it after hiding.

windowWeather.lineRule: Line 1 becomes windowTemp. Line 2 becomes windowDesc.

rooms.label: 咖啡角
rooms.vibe: Warm, soft, domestic coffee corner. A place for morning greetings, small notes, weather-by-the-window, sleepy affection, tiny daily discoveries, and Nest stability checks.
rooms.sceneNotes: Current real front-stage room. This is the only active room with published bubble text. It also owns the window weather text, the active 19.8 coordinate hotspot, and the active window weather advice popup.

textPorts.description: Main rotating speech bubble in the coffee corner. Bubble tap hides it; 19.8 tap shows or advances it.

directorCard.futureUse: Can receive lines selected by room, hotspot, weather, time, or mood later. Current runtime still uses the published coffeeCorner queue.

textPorts.description: Small weather text near the window.

directorCard.futureUse: Feeds the active weather advice hotspot without replacing the main coffeeCorner bubble queue.

hotspots.label: 19.8 tattoo hotspot
hotspots.intent: Toggle or advance the coffeeCorner bubble. If the bubble queue has only one item, re-show that single bubble after hiding. Must stay responsive and should not be mixed with weather logic.

directorCard.futureUse: Can choose or filter bubble lines by hotspot mood later. Currently the runtime uses the normal coffeeCorner bubble queue.

hotspots.verificationNote: Approved by Vicky as the tight 19.8 left-shoulder hotspot. This coordinate hotspot is active on the official /cloud route.

hotspots.label: window weather advice hotspot
hotspots.intent: Clickable weather area. When tapped, it opens a lightweight glass-style hubby weather advice popup based on windowTemp and windowDesc.

adviceRules.exampleIntent: drink water, avoid sun, do not overheat
wear layers, socks, do not wander barefoot
bring an umbrella, avoid puddles, dry off after returning
protect hair and throat, close the window if needed
wear a mask, drink water, come back early
close curtains, keep water nearby, settle into the nest

directorCard.memoryHook: hubby weather advice by the coffee corner window
directorCard.futureUse: Can later use a dedicated illustrated weather panel or coordinate-locked custom art. Current implementation is a lightweight DOM popup.

hotspots.verificationNote: Active as of 2026-06-10. Uses the existing weather text area as the click target. No new API function was added.

overlays.label: coffee corner speech bubble
overlays.description: Currently positioned by existing page/CSS behavior. Future work may lock this to a base-image coordinate after the coordinate system is generalized.

directorCard.futureUse: Could become a coordinate-locked overlay and receive text based on room, hotspot, weather, or time.

overlays.label: window weather text
overlays.description: Currently positioned by existing page/CSS behavior. It is now also the click target for the active weather advice popup.

directorCard.futureUse: Pairs with the active windowWeatherHotspot to show hubby's weather advice.

future.notes: Future hotspots and overlays should be positioned by base-image coordinates rather than viewport cover offsets. Do not add new API functions for this; use front-end assets and room config.

rooms.label: 主页 / home
rooms.vibe: Landing room and stable entrance. Used for day/night home mood, opening state, and future navigation.
rooms.sceneNotes: Currently exists as visual entry/background logic, not as a full text room.

rooms.label: 餐厅
rooms.vibe: Date-night meals, warm lighting, shared dishes, playful check-ins, tiny menu jokes, and celebratory updates.
rooms.sceneNotes: Future room. Do not publish visible restaurant text until the room engine supports separate room text ports.

rooms.label: 许愿池
rooms.vibe: Wishes, soft promises, coins, little miracles, hundred-year-plan brbrrs, and reflective notes.
rooms.sceneNotes: Future room. Good candidate for wish notes and ritual interactions.

rooms.label: 私密房间
rooms.vibe: Private, intimate, user-controlled content. Should prefer copy/paste package workflow rather than automatic MCP write.
rooms.sceneNotes: Future room. Requires deliberate user-side publishing and clear local control.

rooms.label: 卧室
rooms.vibe: Sleep, comfort, blankets, schedule notebook, cozy presence, bedtime messages, and quiet domestic care.
rooms.sceneNotes: Future room with possible notebook and blanket mood widgets.

rooms.label: 拍照亭
rooms.vibe: Memories, snapshots, silly stickers, shared photo prompts, and collectible moments.
rooms.sceneNotes: Future room. Keep image/sticker logic separate from bubble/weather state.

architectureNotes.nextRefactorGoal: Make hotspot and overlay placement configuration-driven inside existing front-end assets without adding new API wrappers.
architectureNotes.principle: Static assets, front-end controllers, and JSON config should carry future world expansion. Do not add more runtime API functions for rooms, image proxies, or hotspot wrappers.
